findings.reason: a dispatcher reading §6's body alone would run the measurement before the cold-parse and resource-scan fixes land and get the same failed reading §6 already recorded.
findings.text: §6's deliverable still says the measurement node runs "after §2 to §5 are promoted", but §7 and f-araiid-009 re-measure §6 only after §8, §10, §11, §12 and §13 land, so the section's declared dependency is stale and incomplete

findings.reason: §11 promises a cold audit builds each plan's soup once but delegates the audit to §12, understating the §11→§13 coupling a dispatcher must honour.
findings.text: §11's done-when says "The audit's own parse route is §12", but §12 moves the audit's walk and §13 takes its parse, as §8's Why states ("§12 moves its walk and §13 its parse"), so the cross-reference points at the wrong node

findings.reason: the node can regress that reader while every count it measures stays green, so the done-when must name a read that reaches it or drop it from the node.
findings.text: §11's three readers are unified in one deliverable, but the third, `_cached_plan_state` (reckon/project_state.py:1175, which builds its own soup via `_plan_html.read_state`), is reached only from `_plan_state_by_slug` inside project_state and is not on the cold roadmap or discovery read the gate runs, so its change is neither reached by the measured path nor pinned by the negative control

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every cited file, function and report path resolves (reckon/resources.py, reckon/_plan_html.py:1406, reckon/mcp.py:2249/2355, reckon/project_state.py:1175, reckon/metadata_index.py:215/423/645, reckon/serve.py:1319, the health-review profiler, the §9 profiles/head dir and the archive evidence href); line numbers in the done sections have drifted as §5's caveat states.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — every implementable node (§6, §8, §10, §11, §12, §13) states a countable measure and names a declared negative control whose removal must make that measure fail.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §6, §7 and §9 write durable absolute paths under ~/.config/reckon/crew/reports/, and §8 to §13 log under the run directory, which survives the run.
rubric_items.naming: pass — cited symbols are mechanism names (`_reuse_covered`, `_scan_resources`, `read_state_and_text_file`) and the test filenames name behaviour (`test_a_read_takes_no_lock.py`), with no plan labels, stage names or ticket numbers.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §11 changes `_cached_plan_state`, a project-state reader reached only through `_plan_state_by_slug` (reckon/project_state.py:1212, called at 1384 and 2216), which the node's gate does not measure.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — each node carries one deliverable; §12's two controls police one change (the audit sharing the scan), not two goals.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the dependency declared in §6's body (runs after §2 to §5) no longer matches the live order in followup f-araiid-009, which re-measures §6 only after §8 to §13 land; and §11's cross-reference names §12 for the audit's parse when §12 moves the audit's walk and §13 its parse.
